gloss: to finish, to get by with

definitions.explanation: To bring something to an end.

definitions.gloss: to get by with, to make do

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}を{済|す}ます。
{朝食|ちょうしょく}はパンで{済|す}ます。
examples.english: I make do with bread for breakfast.

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}を{済|す}ませてから{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll go after finishing my errands.

examples.japanese: {昼食|ちゅうしょく}はおにぎりで{済|す}ます。
examples.english: I make do with rice balls for lunch.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}いを{済|す}ませる。
{謝|あやま}らないで{済|す}ますつもり？
examples.english: Do you plan to get by without apologizing?

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}を{済|す}ませた。
{安|やす}いもので{済|す}ませる。
examples.english: To make do with something cheap.

examples.japanese: {お{金|かね}を{払|はら}わないで{済|す}ませた。

notes:
{済|す}ます is a godan verb meaning to finish/complete or to get by/make do with something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {済|す}む (intransitive - to be finished, to be enough)

SENSE 1 - TO FINISH/COMPLETE:
- {宿題|しゅくだい}を{済|す}ます: to finish homework
- {用事|ようじ}を{済|す}ます: to finish errands
- {支払|しはら}いを{済|す}ます: to complete payment
- {準備|じゅんび}を{済|す}ませる: to finish preparations

SENSE 2 - TO GET BY WITH:
- パンで{済|す}ます: to make do with bread
- {安|やす}いもので{済|す}ます: to get by with something cheap
- 〜ないで{済|す}ます: to get by without ~
- {謝|あやま}らないで{済|す}ます: to get by without apologizing

ASPECT:
- {済|す}ませてから: after finishing
- {済|す}ませた: finished (completed)

RELATED:
- {済|す}む: to be finished/done; to suffice
- {終|お}わる/{終|お}える: to end/finish (general)
